summary: Replaces Sprint07 label-filter workaround by loading available labels from LabelEngine and persisting filter selections in PreferenceStore, eliminating per-tab label drift and filter resets on tab switch.

classification.why_application: Wires TaskTracker-specific domain state (task label filter preference) to platform services; contains no reusable infrastructure — only TaskTracker-scoped behavior.
non_goals: Server-side filtering of GET /tasks by label_ids
New backend endpoints beyond thin proxy additions
Any new persistent state owned by TaskTracker
classification.not_platform: The label filter preference key 'tasktracker.task-list/label_filter' and the wiring of LabelEngine + PreferenceStore for this domain view are TaskTracker-specific application behavior, not reusable platform infrastructure.

consumes: LabelEngine GET /api/labels/used?object_type=task — returns { labels: [{ id, name }] } ordered by name ASC; 422 if object_type absent
PreferenceStore GET /api/preferences/{scope}/{key} — returns Dataset (one row) with value field as JSON string, or 404 ApiError
PreferenceStore PUT /api/preferences/{scope}/{key} — body: { value: <any JSON> }; returns PreferenceRecord on 200
Platform contracts: ColumnSchema, Dataset, DatasetMeta from platform_contracts
provides: GET /api/tasks/labels/used — proxies LabelEngine used-labels for object_type=task; returns Dataset
GET /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter — proxies PreferenceStore GET for scope=tasktracker.task-list key=label_filter; returns Dataset or 404 ApiError
PUT /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter — proxies PreferenceStore PUT for scope=tasktracker.task-list key=label_filter; body { label_ids: list[str] }; returns 200 or ApiError
invariants: availableLabels state in frontend is loaded exactly once on TasksPage mount and is never modified by fetchTasks
selectedLabelIds state in frontend is owned exclusively at TasksPage level; fetchTasks does not read or write it
filter selection saved to PreferenceStore is intersected with currently available labels on load to handle stale IDs
When PreferenceStore returns 404 for the filter key, selectedLabelIds defaults to all available label IDs (all selected)
GET /tasks/labels/active endpoint is removed; GET /tasks must not declare label_ids query parameter
failure_modes: LabelEngine unreachable: GET /tasks/labels/used returns empty Dataset (graceful degradation); frontend shows no filter bar
PreferenceStore unreachable on GET: frontend defaults to all labels selected (no error shown)
PreferenceStore unreachable on PUT: save is best-effort; frontend does not surface a save error to the user
LabelEngine 422 (missing object_type): backend must always pass object_type=task; this is a backend programming error, not a user error

consumes: LabelEngine HTTP API at LABEL_ENGINE_URL (env var, default http://localhost:8050): GET /api/labels/used?object_type=task
PreferenceStore HTTP API at PREFERENCE_STORE_URL (env var, default http://localhost:8060): GET /api/preferences/{scope}/{key} and PUT /api/preferences/{scope}/{key}
apiFetch from @platform-ui/api/client — all frontend HTTP calls go through this; prepends /api, routes to TaskTracker backend
provides: GET /api/tasks/labels/used — thin proxy to LabelEngine; returns Dataset { object_type: label, rows: [{id, name}] }
GET /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter — thin proxy to PreferenceStore; returns Dataset (one row: scope, key, value, updated_at) or 404 ApiError
PUT /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter — thin proxy to PreferenceStore; request body { label_ids: list[str] }; returns 200 PreferenceRecord or ApiError

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/tasks/labels/used
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Returns all labels currently attached to any task, sourced from LabelEngine. Used by frontend to populate the stable label filter bar.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Returns the stored label filter selection for tasktracker.task-list. Used by frontend on mount to restore prior filter state.

exposed_surfaces.name: PUT /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Saves the current label filter selection. Called by frontend whenever selectedLabelIds changes.

internal_flow.name: mount_load_available_labels
internal_flow.description: On TasksPage mount, frontend calls GET /api/tasks/labels/used. Backend proxies to LabelEngine GET /api/labels/used?object_type=task and maps the response into a Dataset. Frontend stores rows as availableLabels: TaskLabel[]. On failure or empty result, availableLabels is [] and the filter bar is hidden.

internal_flow.name: mount_load_filter_preference
internal_flow.description: On mount (after available labels are known), frontend calls GET /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter. Backend proxies to PreferenceStore GET /api/preferences/tasktracker.task-list/label_filter. If 200: parse the Dataset row's value field (a JSON string) as string[], intersect with availableLabels IDs, use result as initial selectedLabelIds. If 404: default all availableLabels IDs selected. On other errors: default all selected.

internal_flow.name: fetch_tasks
internal_flow.description: fetchTasks(currentView) fetches task rows for the current tab. It does not touch availableLabels or selectedLabelIds. After fetch, rows are stored in tasks state. Client-side filtering against selectedLabelIds is computed as a derived value (displayedTasks) in the render path.

internal_flow.name: filter_change_persist
internal_flow.description: Whenever selectedLabelIds changes (user toggles a label), frontend calls PUT /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter with { label_ids: Array.from(selectedLabelIds) }. Backend proxies to PreferenceStore PUT /api/preferences/tasktracker.task-list/label_filter with { value: label_ids_array }. Save is best-effort; errors are not surfaced to the user.

internal_flow.name: client_side_filter
internal_flow.description: displayedTasks is derived from tasks and selectedLabelIds in the render path. If availableLabels is empty: show all tasks. If all selected: show all tasks. If none selected: show empty list. Otherwise: show tasks that have at least one label whose id is in selectedLabelIds. This logic is unchanged from Sprint07 except it no longer depends on per-tab label derivation.

internal_flow.name: remove_workaround_artifacts
internal_flow.description: Remove GET /tasks/labels/active endpoint from tasks.py. Remove label_ids Query parameter from GET /tasks handler. Remove label-derivation logic (seen Map loop, setActiveLabels, setSelectedLabelIds calls) from inside fetchTasks in ShellEntry.tsx. Remove activeLabels state variable and replace with availableLabels.
outputs: Cleaned backend and frontend free of Sprint07 workaround code

risks.risk: Mount ordering: if availableLabels fetch is async and selectedLabelIds initialisation runs before it completes, intersection produces empty selection
risks.impact: Filter defaults to all selected (safe fallback) but does not restore the user's prior selection. Must be handled by chaining the preference load after availableLabels resolves.

risks.risk: PreferenceStore value field encoding: GET returns value as JSON.dumps(value_json) — a JSON string of the array. Frontend must JSON.parse this string before treating it as string[].
risks.impact: If frontend reads value without parsing, it gets a string instead of an array and intersection logic silently fails.

risks.risk: LabelEngine Sprint02_ReverseLookup must be deployed before this sprint is activated
risks.impact: GET /tasks/labels/used will return empty Dataset (graceful degradation) if LabelEngine does not have the /api/labels/used endpoint. Filter bar will not appear.
